title: Victoria 3 Native Loader
summary: A native DLL plugin loader for Victoria 3 on Windows, built to fill the gap left by the standard Paradox launcher, which does not conveniently support native DLL injection. Install and enable version-checked native plugins alongside existing mod playsets, including engine extensions that go beyond ordinary game scripting. Includes a plugin SDK; no performance optimization plugin is bundled.

title: [1.15.2] Stockpile Economy Continued
summary: A maintained continuation of Anbeeld's Stockpile Economy, updated for current Victoria 3 with stockpile controls, AI behavior, state priorities, configurable rules, persistence fixes, and 1.15 compatibility work.

title: [1.15.2] Stockpile Economy Continued - Tech & Res
summary: A full replacement Tech & Res compatibility edition of Stockpile Economy Continued for Victoria 3 1.15.x and Tech & Res 1.7, rebuilding stockpile support for 77 physical goods including 28 Tech & Res goods. Use this instead of the normal Stockpile Economy Continued when Tech & Res is enabled.
credits: Based on Anbeeld's Stockpile Economy (ASE). Tech & Res by Mattia10 and contributors.

title: [1.15.2] Private Sector Construction Continued
summary: An unofficial continuation of Dingbat32's Private Sector Construction for Victoria 3 1.15.x, preserving privately owned construction sectors, local construction goods, Construction Regulators, percentage-based government construction spending, AI support, and PSC's diminishing-returns state construction efficiency model.
credits: Original Private Sector Construction by Dingbat32. Original source: github.com/dingbat32/Private-Sector-Construction.

title: [1.15.2] Private Sector Construction Continued - Tech & Res
summary: A full replacement Tech & Res 1.7 compatibility edition of Private Sector Construction Continued for Victoria 3 1.15.x. It merges Tech & Res construction inputs and technologies into PSC, adds Prefabricated Concrete as a fifth local construction tier, and preserves PSC's private-sector, regulator, spending, and diminishing-returns architecture.
credits: Original Private Sector Construction by Dingbat32. Tech & Res by Mattia10 and contributors. Re-derived against current PSC Continued and Tech & Res 1.7.

title: [1.15.2] Better Politics Mod - Victorian Flavor Mod Compatch
summary: A narrow Victoria 3 1.15 compatibility layer for Victorian Flavor Mod 1.5.0 and Better Politics Mod 2.5. It reconciles centralization laws, VFM history/events/ideologies with BPM IDs, preserves shared variables and diplomacy restrictions, and includes targeted BPM 2.5 / 1.15.2 hotfix guards without redistributing either parent mod.
credits: Compatibility patch for Victorian Flavor Mod (Workshop 2880089689) and Better Politics Mod (Workshop 2932134122). Parent mods are not redistributed.

title: [1.15.2] PSC + Stockpile Replacement Pack
summary: A standalone Victoria 3 1.15.x package combining the maintained Private Sector Construction and Stockpile Economy systems in one installation. It includes private construction sectors, Construction Regulators, construction-spending controls, physical goods stockpiles, reserve targets, AI participation, and the current copper integration.
credits: Combined derivative based on Private Sector Construction by Dingbat32 and Stockpile Economy by Anbeeld.

title: [1.15.2] Private Sector Construction + Stockpile Economy - Replacement Pack (Tech & Res Compatible)
summary: The Tech & Res 1.7 edition of the combined PSC + Stockpile replacement pack for Victoria 3 1.15.x. It keeps Tech & Res enabled while combining private construction, Construction Regulators, construction-spending controls, stockpile management, Tech & Res construction inputs and the Prefabricated Concrete tier, with stockpile coverage for Tech & Res physical market goods.
credits: Combined derivative based on Private Sector Construction by Dingbat32 and Stockpile Economy by Anbeeld, with Tech & Res compatibility.

title: [1.15.2] Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul
summary: Moves law enforcement into staffed Government Administration buildings, with law-based police organization and technology-based equipment. Local turmoil reduction scales with staffed administration levels; police also require wages, supplies and bureaucracy.

title: [1.15.2] Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul - Tech & Res
summary: The Tech & Res 1.7 edition of Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul for Victoria 3 1.15.x. It keeps staffed, state-based policing in Government Administrations while preserving Tech & Res administration methods and adding late-game Police Helicopters and Police Drones unlocked through Tech & Res technologies.
credits: Tech & Res by Mattia10 and contributors.

title: [1.15.2] Shattered World - Every State a Country
summary: Updates Shattered World for Victoria 3 1.15, making every starting state an independent country in 1836. The port refreshes country definitions, starting laws, formable-country support and regional strategic objectives, with targeted AI and journal cadence changes for the much larger number of independent countries.

title: [1.15.2] Tech & Res - 3D Model Extension (Work in Progress)
summary: A visual extension for Tech & Res with distinct models for nine modern land unit types and six naval unit types. Includes mechanized infantry, tanks, artillery, marines, modern destroyers, cruisers, battleships, nuclear submarines, fleet carriers and amphibious assault ships. Naval ship designer refits change equipment and appearance as technologies unlock.
credits: Requires Tech & Res. Full model-by-model source credits and acknowledgments are on the Workshop listing.

title: [1.15.2] Home Affairs Institution Overhaul
summary: Replaces the abstract Home Affairs institution with staffed Government Administration and Barracks production methods. Secret Police and Guaranteed Liberties use government personnel and supplies, while the National Guard uses soldiers and military supplies for local disaster response and conscription support. Benefits scale with effective staffing and have defined limits.

title: [1.15.2] Distinct Military Weapons
summary: Separates firearms and artillery into distinct generations of market goods. Arms industries produce the equipment required by each generation of military units, while older weapons remain available to produce and trade. Includes Repeater Infantry, generation-specific naval armaments and fortifications, technology requirements and prestige weapons.

title: Reichskommissariats Plus x Road to 56 Compatch
summary: A clean v3 compatibility patch for Reichskommissariats Plus and The Road to 56, rebuilt against the current parent mods for Hearts of Iron IV 1.20.x. It merges shared country/cosmetic colors, preserves RT56's current German decision categories and requirements, and avoids suppressing current RK+ decisions, events, focuses, and country history.
credits: Unofficial compatibility patch. Parent mods: The Road to 56 (Workshop 820260968) and Reichskommissariats Plus (Workshop 2910757018). All parent-mod credit belongs to their original creators and contributors.

title: Smart Workforce - Auto-Close Full Factories
summary: Optional per-building workforce controls that automatically stop accepting workers when output is blocked or required production inputs are unavailable, then reopen the building when the condition clears.

title: Foreign Workers Auto Refill (140)
summary: Automatically refills foreign workers at customs houses to a configurable target and keeps the supply available for land, sea, and air routes, including Beyond Borders customs.
